No suspiciously distinctive copied passage is apparent in the short A2-U04-L01 SPEAKING AI-practice prompt, but internal inspection cannot establish originality beyond the retained project evidence and no Internet-wide comparison was performed.

limitations: This review covers only the immutable A2-U04-L01 SPEAKING AI-practice prompt and its fresh static machine-report context. It does not assess human or release approval, provider authentication, live-provider behavior, learner outcomes, or Internet-wide originality.
